writesMeaning: True when the tool can submit an on-chain transaction.

journalEffects.read: Reads existing proposal records. Opening the journal can initialize local storage.
journalEffects.propose: May save a simulated proposal locally.
journalEffects.execute: May reserve a signed transaction and record its outcome locally.
journalEffects.reconcile: May record a confirmed outcome and release the pending nonce locally.

tools.name: read_account
tools.description: Read confirmed account, lending book exposure, mock idle assets, policy, remaining grants and submitted campaign transactions.
guarantees: Checks account, adapter and circuit bindings against the 1952 manifest. Reads actual lending-book exposure and idle mock assets separately.
Includes recorded submissions for the fixed campaign from the local journal.

tools.name: read_market
tools.description: Read a normalized quote from the 1952 inventory-backed mock and request separate, informational 196 OKX market data for the chosen input.
guarantees: Returns the on-chain mock quote and policy minimum for the chosen input on 1952. The separate informational OKX quote on chain 196 can be unavailable.

tools.name: simulate_and_propose_swap
tools.description: Simulate exact WOKB mock input and minimum mUSDC output chosen by the owner-authorized agent. Save typed parameters and immutable deadline under a proposal ID.
guarantees: Checks the current grant, idle input and campaign cap. Simulates the operator’s exact mock WOKB input and minimum mock USDC output before saving a new proposal.
The saved proposal fixes the account, route, raw amounts and five-minute deadline.

tools.name: execute_swap
tools.description: Execute or reconcile one previously simulated fixed-pair swap on 1952, using its persisted proposal ID.
guarantees: Rechecks the proposal, grant and pending simulation before signing a zero-value call to the configured 1952 account. Swap output goes to that account.
The journal allows at most one submitted swap per campaign and reserves the signed hash before broadcast.

tools.name: simulate_denied_borrow
tools.description: Simulate a fixed 1-raw-unit borrow by the swap operator. On an exact authorization denial, save its bounded negative-demo proposal.
guarantees: A new negative-demo proposal requires an absent borrow grant and an eth_call returning OperatorNotAuthorized for the fixed one-raw-unit borrow.

tools.name: mine_denied_borrow
tools.description: Once per account campaign, submit the simulated 1-raw-unit unauthorized borrow with explicit gas to demonstrate a mined revert. Costs testnet gas.
guarantees: Requires both execution and mined-rejection enablement. Rechecks the absent grant and exact denial before submitting the fixed one-raw-unit borrow with a 300,000 gas limit.
The journal allows at most one submitted negative-demo transaction per campaign. A mined revert spends test OKB gas.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Read canonical receipt, matching event or decoded replay, block and resulting authorization, without submitting.
guarantees: Checks the reserved hash and signed transaction against the canonical block. Swap verification checks settlement events, approvals and balance changes.
Negative-demo verification checks the reverted receipt, empty logs and authorization replay. Receipt-window state mismatches are reported for review.
